name: 의녀
phase: Front concept only, pending visual approval
designDescription: An elegant young female Korean Joseon healer with large gentle eyes, LONG flowing dark hair, PINK BLOSSOM hair ornaments and lavender ribbons. Graceful pale LAVENDER AND IVORY hanbok with muted dark-jade trim and delicate gold floral embroidery, layered full skirt and small light shoes. Holds a small BLACK LACQUERED MEDICINE CASE with GOLD edging and a PINK LOTUS emblem at waist level, and a fine silver acupuncture needle in the other hand; small embroidered herb pouch. Match the flower-adorned lavender healer reference, not a plain teal nurse or a short-bun civilian. The medical case is a small case or basket, not a wand.
